verses.text: A song for going up to worship. Let Israel say: "They have attacked me many times since I was young.
They have attacked me many times since I was young, but they have never defeated me.
Ploughmen ploughed across my back. They made their rows long."
But the LORD does what is right. He has cut me free from the ropes of the wicked.
Let all who hate Zion be put to shame and turned back.
Let them be like grass on a flat roof, which dries up before it can grow,
which no one can gather into their hands or carry in their arms.
Let no one who passes by say to them, "May the LORD bless you. We bless you in the name of the LORD."
